hypothesis: A faster music-specific path to controllable, repeatable visual work with reliable output, not generic graphics novelty.
scenario: Use the same authorized music excerpt to import, analyze, play/synchronize, edit a scene, render/export and reopen. Then replace the track, change timing, use a new preset, disable a backend and recover. Compare actual output and editing effort, not only generation latency.
failure_cases: Stub backend produces plausible but wrong output
metrics: Time to useful visualization and revision
